notes.title: Release Week Patch April 23
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This patch fixes various bugs that have been found throughout release week.

- Fixed soft lock in night club if you get stuck between couch and table
- Fixed second playthrough being bugged unless you restart the game
- Fixed continue game not properly starting fresh from the save point 
- Added slight cooldown to memory enter/exit to fix bug where if you spam spacebar you can fall through the level

Thanks for all the interest in the game. :)
